thread.title: Volkswagen Group introduces new cross-brand management structure for greater efficiency
thread.title_full: Volkswagen Group introduces new cross-brand management structure for greater efficiency

author: T. R. Shockley
title: Volkswagen Group introduces new cross-brand management structure for greater efficiency
text:
The Volkswagen Group's Brand Group Core (BGC), which includes Volkswagen Passenger Cars, Škoda, SEAT&CUPRA, and Volkswagen Commercial Vehicles, is introducing a new steering model aimed at increasing efficiency and competitiveness. Starting in January 2026, the "Brand Group Core Board of Management" will serve as the main decision-making body for cross-brand matters.
The initiative is designed to streamline processes and decision-making within the BGC. According to the company, this will involve reducing the number of board members across its four volume brands by about one third by summer 2026. Over time, management structures are expected to become even more streamlined.
The new model seeks to maximize synergies and scale benefits among the brands. Operational activities are expected to be implemented more quickly within the group, while strategic focus areas such as software and batteries will remain at the broader group level. The approach also aims to distribute responsibilities more evenly, leveraging regional and specialist expertise where it can benefit the organization most.
A key aspect of this change involves production governance. The company projects that reorganizing production management could unlock cumulative savings of one billion euros by 2030. Production operations at over 20 locations worldwide will be organized into five regions with regional managers responsible for planning and logistics across brands and countries. This system began on the Iberian Peninsula with local plants forming a cross-brand cluster.
Volkswagen states that these measures are crucial for meeting long-term return targets: "The approved measures are a key lever for achieving a sustainable increase in BGC’s returns. The new cross-brand steering model with its clearly-defined responsibilities and swift decision-making will boost the competitiveness of the entire Brand Group Core model range."
Implementation of these changes begins in January 2026 with full completion expected by summer 2026.
